name: WBS — Trade Fair Assistant — WF-A Lead Capture

nodes.name: Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: select Header Auth credential, header X-Trade-Fair-Key. Set exact browser origins. Public HTML must use an authenticated server-side proxy; never embed this secret in HTML. Source is metadata, not authority.

nodes.name: Generate Server UUID
nodes.notes: Server-only UUID; never copied from the request body. No Code module allowlist or VPS environment change is needed.

nodes.name: Normalize Input
nodes.notes: Uses the server-only UUID from the Crypto node. Preserves original parsed JSON; no Code module imports.

nodes.name: Duplicate Check + Persist Lead
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: select a dedicated PostgreSQL application credential after applying trade_fair_schema.sql. Duplicate lookup and insert execute atomically in one function. Both output paths are guarded before any success response.
